notes.lengths: target L values in record rows; the runner fits L to the token target and records the accepted L
notes.consumed_by_depth: K per depth: depth 1 reads 20 rows, depth 2 reads 60, depth 3 reads 200
notes.token_targets_by_depth: K sets a hard floor on L: the K consumed records plus the minimum distractor budget must fit, so an 8K row is infeasible at K=60 and 32768 is infeasible at K=200. Only feasible cells are scheduled, and an infeasible one is rejected loudly rather than truncated
notes.variants_per_world: one primary length per semantic task; the (L,K,H) grid varies across worlds, not as three copies of one task
notes.worlds_per_cell: pilot scale; raise for a production bank
notes.padding: L - K rows are same-schema distractors: exposure and interference, never semantic scale
